newsitem.title: ITALY: IRI Spa 1996 net profit 184 bln lire. [CORRECTED 21:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: IRI Spa 1996 net profit 184 bln lire. [CORRECTED 21:30 GMT]

text.p: Net financial debt 9.4 trln vs 22.5 trln

Note - Financial holding IRI said the 1996 net profit was after 2.5 trillion lire of charges and receipt of some 3.5 trillion for the transfer of state telecommunications holding Stet from IRI to the Treasury ahead of its privatisation.
It said group consolidated profit was 431 billion lire, compared with (corrects from "a rise of") 638 billion in 1995, despite significant losses at Alitalia and Finmeccanica.
Consolidated financial debt was 26.1 trillion, down some 30 trillion, mostly related to Stet, IRI said in a statement.
IRI said it forecast further improvements in the year ahead.
